description:
The Kafka client is configured to connect to the bootstrap servers `kafka-broker-1.example.com:9092,kafka-broker-2.example.com:9092` using the SASL SSL protocol. It will authenticate with Kerberos, where the client SASL mechanism is **GSSAPI**, the Kerberos service name is **kafka**, and Kerberos support is enabled. The required secrets are the JAAS secret named **my-jaas-secret**, the keytab secret **my-keytab-secret**, and the krb5 configuration secret **my-krb5-secret**. Zookeeper connectivity is set to `zookeeper-1.example.com:2181/dcos-service-confluent-kafka`.

The REST proxy service, identified as **rest‑proxy**, will be deployed on nodes with the **master** role. Two instances will run, each allocated 2 CPU shares, 2048 MB of memory, and a JVM heap of 1024 MB. The listener protocol is **https**, with client authentication required (SSL client auth = true) and the keystore secret **my-keystore**. HTTP access‑control is permissive, allowing methods **GET,POST,PUT** from any origin (`*`). The cipher suite list includes `TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA256,TLS_DHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_DHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256,TLS_DHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_DHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA256,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_CBC_SHA256,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_GCM_SHA384,TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_256_CBC_SHA384`. Virtual networking is enabled and the proxy will join the **dcos** virtual network. Finally, the Avro serializer should use the schema‑registry endpoint at `http://schema-registry.example.com:8081`.
